frequency_question: What proportion of administrative agency recognition termination proceedings by the Department of Education are fully completed and finalized within 101 days from initiation?
membership_rule: Includes all formal proceedings initiated by the Department of Education to limit, suspend, or terminate the recognition of an accrediting agency under the Higher Education Act. Excludes voluntary relinquishments of recognition.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major contested or full-scale recognition review cycles examined; all exceeded 100 days significantly due to mandatory procedural safeguards.
known_gaps: Few formal terminal revocations occur relative to routine renewals, making the exact count of total historical termination dockets small.
skeleton: Administrative termination proceedings under 34 CFR 602.41-602.45 require: (1) Senior Department official initial decision (min 60-90 days for briefing/response), (2) Appeal to the Secretary (min 60 days), and (3) Mandatory procedural due process windows. The absolute minimum physical time for these statutory steps exceeds 180 to 240 days under optimal conditions.
multiplier: 1 item per proceeding, minimum regulatory timeline length vs available window
validity_reason: Statutory and regulatory procedural timeframes under the Higher Education Act and 34 CFR Part 602 remain fixed unless Congress amends the underlying laws.
